heldReason: Q3(a), the food-poisoning bacteria question (18 marks). The scheme prints a five-column table (bacteria / source / high-risk foods / factors affecting growth / symptoms). The provenance gate checks options against the scheme MARKDOWN, and that markdown interleaves the columns line by line, so a multi-word cell like "raw or undercooked meat" is split across other columns' text and is not contiguous. About half the cells fail. Shipping this needs examiner-reports/home-economics/schemes/2025-hl.md re-extracted with table awareness, which changes provenance for every card built from that scheme and needs its own verification pass. Not a card-level fix.
